Interface BookDao

All Known Implementing Classes:
BookDaoImpl
public interface BookDao
Data access contract for Book records. Author: Farid Rahmani Contribution: Defined the DAO interface so controllers/services depend on an abstraction, not a concrete JDBC implementation. Purpose: decouples the rest of the application from how books are persisted. Every query returns fully populated Book objects (writer, genre and bookshelf already joined in), so calling code never has to run follow-up queries.

    • search

      List<Book> search(String titleContains, Integer writerId, Integer genreId, Integer bookshelfId, String readingStatus) throws SQLException
      Returns the books matching the given optional filters. A null or blank value for a given filter means "do not filter by this field".
      Parameters:
      titleContains - text that must appear in the title or in the writer's name (case-insensitive), or null
      writerId - restrict to this writer's id, or null for any writer
      genreId - restrict to this genre's id, or null for any genre
      bookshelfId - restrict to this bookshelf's id, or null for any bookshelf
      readingStatus - restrict to this reading status, or null for any status
      Returns:
      the list of books matching the given filters
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails
